title: Gravitational Vacuum Polarization: Decoupling and the Conformal Anomaly
summary: A compact form of the stress tensor $\langle T^{ab}T^{cd}\rangle$ correlation function of a quantum scalar field of arbitrary mass $m$ and curvature coupling $ξ$ is presented, with particular emphasis on decoupling in the $m\to\infty$ limit and infrared origin of the conformal anomaly as $m \to 0$. The Ward Identity (WI) of covariant conservation is verified for the full second order metric variation of the one-loop effective action, of which $\langle T^{ab}T^{cd}\rangle$ is part, including local contact terms.
